summary.text: Brad Starnes is a Republican who has represented Kansas Senate District 22 in Riley County since 2025.
He serves on the Agriculture and Natural Resources, Assessment and Taxation, Education, and Federal and State Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: According to his Kansas Legislature profile, Starnes's spouse is Mari Starnes.

He is also a member of the Senate Select Committee on Veterans Affairs, the 2025 Special Committees on Federal and State Affairs and on Taxation, and the 2026 Special Committee on Protecting Children from Online Harm.
